tools.name: ticket.status.transition
tools.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the caller read the instance in. An instance in another state refuses the move as the veto stale, before anything else is checked, so a retry that finds its move made is stale with the state it moved to. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

id.description: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

tools.name: ticket.timers.fireTimer
tools.description: Fires a deadline that is due and has not fired: marks it fired and moves the status by its then, recording the outcome; a veto or a missing permission the move meets leaves the status as it is and the deadline fired. A deadline whose until holds is cancelled instead. On a deadline not due, fired already or not started it changes nothing. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; the engine's runner calls it on every due deadline, every sweepMs.

id.description: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

tools.name: ticket.timers.resetTimer
tools.description: Starts a deadline again from what it starts from now, the create, the status's entry into its state or its field's value, so it is due afterMs after it and not fired: a snooze or a fire is undone. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline with nothing to start from now, or whose until holds.

id.description: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.

tools.name: ticket.timers.snoozeTimer
tools.description: Moves a started deadline's due time to dueAt, and a fired one fires again then. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline not started, cancelled, or whose until holds.

dueAt.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds.

id.description: The key of the Ticket row the operation runs on.
